// legacygen writes legacy-format fixtures with the jpegli encoder as of
// jpegs v0.2.0 (before the SSSS=16 / predictor 5,6 fixes). Each fixture is
// <name>.jpg plus its source <name>.pgm, and is verified to round-trip
// through the v0.2.0 decoder.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"image"
	"image/color"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/jpfielding/jpegs/pkg/compress/jpegli"
)

func main() {
	out := os.Args[1]
	rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(356))
	type fx struct {
		name string
		img  image.Image
		pred int
	}
	// 16-bit image whose horizontal steps are often exactly 32768 (SSSS=16)
	// mixed with noise and negative odd vertical gradients.
	ssss16 := func(w, h int) *image.Gray16 {
		m := image.NewGray16(image.Rect(0, 0, w, h))
		for y := 0; y < h; y++ {
			for x := 0; x < w; x++ {
				v := uint16(rng.Intn(64)) + uint16(3*y)
				if (x/2+y)%2 == 1 {
					v += 32768
				}
				m.SetGray16(x, y, colorG16(v))
			}
		}
		return m
	}
	rand16 := image.NewGray16(image.Rect(0, 0, 13, 7))
	for i := 0; i < 13*7; i++ {
		rand16.SetGray16(i%13, i/13, colorG16(uint16(rng.Intn(65536))))
	}
	grad8 := image.NewGray(image.Rect(0, 0, 16, 16))
	for i := range grad8.Pix {
		grad8.Pix[i] = byte(i*7 + i/16*3)
	}
	fxs := []fx{
		{"ssss16-p1-16x8", ssss16(16, 8), 1},
		{"ssss16-p5-16x8", ssss16(16, 8), 5},
		{"ssss16-p6-16x8", ssss16(16, 8), 6},
		{"ssss16-p7-16x8", ssss16(16, 8), 7},
		{"random16-p1-13x7", rand16, 1},
		{"gradient8-p1-16x16", grad8, 1},
	}
	for _, f := range fxs {
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		if err := jpegli.Encode(&buf, f.img, &jpegli.Options{Predictor: f.pred}); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		back, err := jpegli.Decode(bytes.NewReader(buf.Bytes()))
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(pix(back), pix(f.img)) {
			panic(f.name + ": v0.2.0 round trip mismatch")
		}
		must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, f.name+".jpg"), buf.Bytes(), 0o644))
		must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, f.name+".pgm"), pgm(f.img), 0o644))
		fmt.Println(f.name, buf.Len())
	}
}

func colorG16(v uint16) color.Gray16 { return color.Gray16{Y: v} }

func pix(img image.Image) []byte {
	switch m := img.(type) {
	case *image.Gray:
		return m.Pix
	case *image.Gray16:
		return m.Pix
	}
	return nil
}

func pgm(img image.Image) []byte {
	b := img.Bounds()
	maxv := 255
	if _, ok := img.(*image.Gray16); ok {
		maxv = 65535
	}
	return append([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("P5\n%d %d\n%d\n", b.Dx(), b.Dy(), maxv)), pix(img)...)
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
